External links for this lesson. Every link below was checked with `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200) and the page title confirmed. The regulation text quoted in the lesson comes from this repo's `sources/` copies; the Cornell links are verified-loading mirrors for checking current text. CAP's accreditation checklists are not public and are not quoted anywhere in this course.

- **[Cornell LII: 42 CFR 493.1773, Basic inspection requirements for all laboratories](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/42/493.1773)** — what CMS or a CMS agent may require during an inspection: samples, interviews, observation, access, records. Use it to re-check current wording before quoting. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).
- **[Cornell LII: 42 CFR 493.1105, Retention requirements](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/42/493.1105)** — the CLIA retention periods, including corrected reports and the pointer to 21 CFR 606.160(d). Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).
- **[Cornell LII: 42 CFR 493.1231, Confidentiality of patient information](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/42/493.1231)** — the one-sentence confidentiality standard. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).
- **[Cornell LII: 21 CFR 606.160, Records](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/606.160)** — FDA's blood-establishment records rule, including the retention interval in (d). Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).
- **[Cornell LII: 21 CFR 11.10, Controls for closed systems](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/11.10)** — access limits, audit trails, record copies and retrieval for electronic records. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).
- **[FDA: Blood Establishment Computer System Validation in the User's Facility](https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/blood-establishment-computer-system-validation-users-facility)** — the FDA guidance page (guidance, not regulation): interface validation, interface error monitoring, regression after change. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).
- **[CAP: Laboratory Accreditation Program](https://www.cap.org/laboratory-improvement/accreditation/laboratory-accreditation-program)** — the accreditor's public description: deeming authority, on-site inspections every two years, peer inspectors. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200; title "Laboratory Accreditation Program - CAP").
- **[CAP: Accreditation Checklists](https://www.cap.org/laboratory-improvement/accreditation/accreditation-checklists)** — CAP's public page about its checklists, including the custom checklist built from each laboratory's test menu. The checklists themselves are for participating laboratories. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200; title "Accreditation Checklists - CAP").
- **[CMS: Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA)](https://www.cms.gov/medicare/quality/clinical-laboratory-improvement-amendments)** — CMS's program landing page; check it for current notices, which are time-sensitive. I confirmed the page loads and its title; I did not review everything on it. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-13 (HTTP 200).
- **[CAP Accreditation: 10 Steps on the Path to Laboratory Excellence](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3ero7W1rCvw)** (channel "capathologists", from oEmbed `author_name`; the CAP's own channel) — the accreditor's overview video, embedded in the lesson. It is general, aimed at labs seeking accreditation, and not about IT; I did not review its full content. Verified embeddable via YouTube oEmbed on 2026-11-13; title and author read from the oEmbed response. No CDC or CMS inspection-readiness video was found that was both on-topic and verifiably embeddable (CDC offers a past webinar listing, linked below, with no embeddable recording confirmed).

Earlier modules this lesson builds on: [Where CLIA and CAP Reach a Blood Center](../where-clia-and-cap-reach-a-blood-center/index.qmd), [The LIS and the Test Report](../the-lis-and-the-test-report/index.qmd), [Instruments, Middleware and Performance Verification](../instruments-middleware-and-performance-verification/index.qmd), [Proficiency Testing and the LIS](../proficiency-testing-and-the-lis/index.qmd), [Vendor Release Intake for BECS](../../release-management-and-sdlc/vendor-release-intake-for-becs/index.qmd), [Risk-Based Testing and Regression](../../release-management-and-sdlc/risk-based-testing-and-regression/index.qmd), [Filing a Biological Product Deviation Report](../../fda-and-aabb-in-practice/filing-a-biological-product-deviation-report/index.qmd).

## Keep learning

- **[How to minimize your risk of a clinical laboratory accreditation citation](https://myadlm.org/cln/CLN-Daily/2026/How-to-minimize-your-risk-of-a-clinical-laboratory-accreditation-citation)** (ADLM's Clinical Laboratory News, a professional association's publication) — practitioner advice on avoiding accreditation citations. General, not IT-specific, and not a source for any CAP requirement. - **[Getting ready for your laboratory inspection](https://mlo-online.com/diagnostics/poct/article/13008694/getting-ready-for-your-laboratory-inspection)** (MLO Online, a trade publication) — a readiness article for laboratory staff; useful for hearing how labs think about inspection prep.
